$comment: Pinned base images for reproducible multi-arch builds (feature 002, FR-032/FR-034). `digest` must be a multi-platform manifest-list digest covering linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. `pnpm images:build` refuses to build while any digest is empty; run `pnpm images:build --resolve` on a machine with a Docker daemon to fill them from the registry, then commit the result.
